newsitem.title: USA: Size of Halter planned IPO now three mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Size of Halter planned IPO now three mln shares.

text.p: Halter Marine Group Inc has formally set terms of its proposed initial public offering at three million shares in an estimated range of $12 to $14 each.

Parent company Trinity Industries Inc said last month it had changed its original plans to sell the entire company in an IPO and instead would sell only a 20 percent stake, but the exact terms were just released in a regulatory filing made late last week.
Trinity had said it would consider selling its remaining stake in Halter over time.
The IPO is tentatively slated for the week of September 23, according to lead underwriter Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities.
The builder of ships, barges, and inland tow boats, based in Gulfport, Miss., had originally filed in June for an offering of 15 million shares with no estimated price.
"Trinity has announced its intention, subject to satisfaction of certain conditions, to divest itself of its remaining ownership interest in (Halter)," the filing said.
Halter is due to eventually acquire the ocean-going marine vessel business of Trinity. It posted 1995 net income of $15.7 million based on revenues of $250.6 million.
